We are currently seeking full-time warehouse employees for our new, state-of-the-art distribution center in Oss. This is a long-term position with excellent opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and multicultural environment. Important! This is a physically active role. The department is located at a higher level in the distribution center, so comfort with heights is essential. Outbound: Organize trolleys and dollies for pick-up. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure products are delivered to the correct locations. This role can be physically demanding, particularly when handling heavier items such as alcohol and cigarettes. Emballage: Manage and recycle empty packaging materials such as bottles, crates, and cans. You will also check trolleys for reuse. This role may involve physically demanding tasks based on the materials handled. You must be flexible, ready to work on each department. What skills do you have? Good command of the English language. Lung cancer and mesothelioma remain among the deadliest cancers worldwide, highlighting the need for more effective and targeted therapies.
